The GS-protected helper derives its cookie operations from the real WCHAR[64] buffer.

matching/cl/mpcl.cpp.evidence: Actual SP1 /GL + /LTCG env_size compile emits all 45 retail bytes with /O1; /O2 differs at offset 13. The empty thread_print body is also exact but does not distinguish optimization flags.

matching/cl/util_watson.cpp.evidence: Actual complete Watson family /GL+/LTCG probes match whole function bodies and independently resolved data/import/literal referents. wchar_t typedef mode and genuine L-empty initializer preserve the observed unsigned-short pointer type; /GF models observed sharing. /O1 is experimental outside the measured family. Explicit /Ob1 on this callee unit as well as the wrapper unit prevents cross-unit inlining and preserves the four observed 9-byte wrappers when the full Watson family is linked.

matching/cl/loadui.cpp.evidence: PDB module 6 (loadui.obj) bodies, measured with the installed SP1 tools. /Zc:wchar_t- is required: all wide pointers, L"" literals and the CRT prototypes mangle as unsigned short (PAG, G) and the retail literal symbols use the typedef-wchar_t spelling. This unit is built with gl=false because the retail bodies are plain-c2 output: their prologues are the non-LTCG `lea ebp,[esp-frame]` layout (0x409331 lea ebp,[esp-0xa38], 0x409756 lea ebp,[esp-0x790], 0x40983c lea ebp,[esp-0xf8c]), while an actual /GL + /LTCG build of the same source emits an aligned esp-relative frame (mov ebp,esp; and esp,-8) and scores 5.66/6.96 instead of 100/100. gl=false is a measured per-unit fact, not a change to the project /GL default. /O1 is the measured optimization for these bodies. msvcrt.lib supplies the MSVCR80.dll import definitions for wcslen/wcscpy_s/wcsncpy_s/wcsncat_s/wcscmp/_itow_s/_wtoi/_wtol/_wdupenv_s/free/memset; the linker-generated __chkstk/__alloca_probe helper is byte-identical to retail. Default /GS supplies the observed ___security_cookie frame checks.
